title.narrative: Danish Egyptian Dialogue Initiative Danish-Arab Partnership Programme 2017-2022

description.narrative:
The strategic programme objective of the Danish-Arab Partnership Programme is to provide economic opportunities by advancing governance standards in public institutions, civil society and businesses.
The programme has six engagements under the two thematic programmes 1) Governance Standards and 2) Economic Opportunities. With the aims of enhancing Governance Standards for rights-holders and duty-bearers in the areas of Human Rights, Gender Equality, and Free Media. And increase the Economic Opportunities for young people, by strengthening flexible labour markets, decent jobs, and social dialogue, as well as employment opportunities, youth participation and financial engagement through youth entrepreneurship.

title.narrative:
Thematic objective: Cultural dialogue/exchange between Egypt and Denmark including exchange of expertise strengthened. Networks/cooperation initiated, nourished, and sustainability enhanced.
Impact Indicator: Exchange and networks between Danish and Egyptian cultural actors and experts increased in quantity and depth. Danish and Egyptian art and culture made available to new audiences and the wider public evident in number and type of activities. Youth engaged in art and culture.
Outcome: Environment conducive to establishing dialogue and exchange between Denmark and Egypt in the cultural fields is strengthened through partnerships based projects and networks.
Outcome Indicator: A large number of partnership based projects established. Continued exchange between Danish and Egyptian cultural actors and experts beyond DEDI’s incubation.

target.value:
Approximately 20 engagements established and continued. expertise exchanged. sustainable models of networking proposed and experimented. and Danish and Egyptian art and culture made available to a wider audience including in areas outside the traditional centres of art and culture.
More (20 whether small or large) partnership projects and networks appear. with longer life span and wider outreach.

actual.value:
Artists Symposium - implemented Eight Danish and Egyptian visual artists participated, two days in Cairo and eight days in Aswan. Very positive feedback. Second part planned for May in Copenhagen and Hanstholm
Artists Residency - implemented 15 Danish and Egyptian artists gathered for two weeks in October Exhibition from October 28 to November 4 at Bardo Clubhouse with 400 visitors

title.narrative:
Thematic objective: Strengthening media professionalism and creativity in Egypt and Denmark
Objetive: Professionalism and creativity raised through dialogue, capacity building and knowledge sharing by the DEDI Media Club (DMC), training courses, conferences and exchanges between professional. DEDI media club continues its work to raise awareness of media developments, professional standards and more urgent issues related to the Danish and Egyptian media scenes.
Outcome: Professional standards adhered to, creativity strengthened; stronger ties between Danish and Egyptian media established
Outcome indicator: Professional training of journalists conducted and impact monitored. A number of partnerships established between Danish and Egyptian media outlets. DEDI media club arranges a number of meetings and debates covering issues of relevance for the media development in Egypt and Denmark

target.value:
Over the five-year period DEDIs achievements within Media are expected to ensure higher professional standards. DEDI Media Club continues to be a relevant and influential actor on the Egyptian media scene.
Larger and closer networks covering Egyptian Danish media exchange Means for monitoring impact of training developed. DEDI media club continues activities. with larger impact and creativity of/ in activities. established. Sustainability reached.

actual.value: DEDI Media Club has been offering a space and platform for dialogue, debates, introductions to new trends and technologies in the field of Media as well as knowledge sharing and capacity building. Based on the successes of DEDI Media Club, DEDI proposes a program that focuses on Science Journalism and Photo Journalism.
